operationName: Operation Swords of Iron (Israel) / October 7 War
heroHeadline: Israel and Hamas at Impasse Over Disarmament Terms in Gaza Deal Framework
heroSubtitle: On Day 965 (June 2, 2026), IDF drones and artillery struck Jabalia refugee camp, Al-Zawayda, and Al-Bureij in central Gaza, killing at least 2 and wounding 40 in the daily reporting period. New Mossad Director Roman Gofman officially assumed leadership as Netanyahu declared Iran's regime is "destined to pass." AP analysis confirmed the October 2025 ceasefire is increasingly hollow: Israel controls ~60% of Gaza, Phase 2 talks are paralyzed, no stabilization force deployed, and less than $1B of $17B pledged reconstruction funds disbursed. At least 932 Palestinians have been killed since the ceasefire took effect. Hamas and PIJ unanimously rejected the Mladenov disarmament road map.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Hamas, UN OCHA, UNRWA, WHO, ICJ, ICC, Times of Israel, Al Jazeera, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, IMEMC, WAFA, WFP, CBS News, Washington Post, Palestine Chronicle, UN News, Arab News, Al-Monitor. Gaza death toll: 74,000+ confirmed killed since Oct 7, 2023.
